name: VOIDENTRY-law-ignored

name: VOIDENTRY-door-unchecked
old:
const at = [d.pos[0] + d.normal[0] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET, d.pos[1] + d.normal[1] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET, d.pos[2] + d.normal[2] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET];
      if (standsAt(at)) return at;
new:
const at = [d.pos[0] + d.normal[0] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET, d.pos[1] + d.normal[1] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET, d.pos[2] + d.normal[2] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET];
      return at;
note: the nearest door taken without asking for a floor: the copy's outward door wins again

name: VOIDENTRY-door-landing-reversed
old: const at = [d.pos[0] + d.normal[0] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET, d.pos[1] + d.normal[1] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET, d.pos[2] + d.normal[2] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET];
new: const at = [d.pos[0] - d.normal[0] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET, d.pos[1] - d.normal[1] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET, d.pos[2] - d.normal[2] * ENTER_DOOR_OFFSET];
note: a door landing against its normal is not DFU's (radius + 0.4 along it)

name: VOIDENTRY-doors-farthest-first

name: VOIDENTRY-markers-from-the-check

name: VOIDENTRY-no-marker-arm
old:
const at = [m.pos[0], m.pos[1] + MARKER_UP_OFFSET, m.pos[2]];
      if (standsAt(at)) return at;
new:
const at = [m.pos[0], m.pos[1] + MARKER_UP_OFFSET, m.pos[2]];
      if (standsAt(at)) return null;
note: DFU's marker arm dropped from the failsafe: a room whose doors all land over nothing is refused though its marker stands

name: VOIDENTRY-marker-not-lifted

name: VOIDENTRY-void-above
old: return box ? { at, belowY: box.min[1] - INTERIOR_VOID_DROP } : null;
new: return box ? { at, belowY: box.min[1] + INTERIOR_VOID_DROP } : null;
